statement: PRE-REGISTERED TEST. Pattern skill is judged on all Missouri county x measure rows (5 x 116 = 580) after BOTH the registered prediction and the partisanship-only baseline are relevelled to the certified statewide share (scoring.relevel). H1: the registered model's absolute county error is smaller than the baseline's.
scoring: One-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test on the 580 paired differences, alpha 0.05; report per-measure skill = 1 - RMSE_model/RMSE_baseline as well. Interval calibration: fraction of rows inside [pred_low_90, pred_high_90] reported against the 0.90 target; 0.85-0.95 counts as calibrated. Level: each bracket scored hit/miss separately; brackets are judgement, not model, and are reported as such.

statement: DIAGNOSTIC (the geo in geo-fluid). The registered model uses no spatial machinery. If neighbouring counties share local factors the model does not see, its county errors will cluster in space: Moran's I of the relevelled Amendment 3 errors (queen adjacency, row-standardised W, spatial.moran) will be positive and significant at 0.05 by permutation.
metric: Moran's I of county errors, Amendment 3
scoring: If confirmed: the spatial layer holds information the registered model left on the table - the hybrid (spatial-lag) model is the next build. If not: the residual is noise and the spatial layer's job is description. Either way goes to FINDINGS.md.

statement: DIAGNOSTIC (who shows up). Turnout composition is assumed, not modelled. If the misses are the counties whose electorate changed most, the county error will correlate with the change in turnout: Pearson r between the relevelled Amendment 3 county error and (2026 votes cast / 2018 votes cast) across the 116 jurisdictions.
scoring: |r| >= 0.3 means a surge or collapse electorate drove the misses and turnout composition must be modelled next; below 0.3 the assumption held well enough. Reported with its sign (positive = we over-predicted where turnout grew).

statement: The 2026 Amendment 3 county vote is at least as party-coupled as the 2024 abortion vote: OLS slope of logit(NO share) on logit(2024 Dem two-party share) >= the 2024 slope.
scoring: STEEPEN if slope_2026 > slope_2024 + 0.05; RELAX if < slope_2024 - 0.05; HOLD otherwise. Result goes to FINDINGS.md as the first Module 5 order-parameter reading, whichever way it lands.
